mapper.sql: id, received_date, supplier_id, purchase_id, purchase_sn, received_user_name, product_type, project_id, monomer_id, area_id
mapper.select:
select a.*, ap.id as 'batch.id', ap.name as 'batch.name', p.id as 'project.id', p.name as 'project.name', p.short_name as 'project.shortName', p.serial_number as 'project.serialNumber', ss.id as 'supplier.id', ss.name as 'supplier.name', pm.id as 'monomer.id', pm.name as 'monomer.name', pa.id as 'area.id', pa.name as 'area.name' FROM project_reject_detail as a LEFT JOIN contract_project p ON p.id = a.project_id left join scm_supplier as ss on a.supplier_id = ss.id left join plan_monomer as pm on a.monomer_id = pm.id left join plan_area as pa on a.area_id = pa.id left join enclosure_plan as ap on a.enclosure_plan_id = ap.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.review_status = 2
and a.project_id = #{projectId}
AND a.project_id in
#{projectId}
and a.product_type = #{productType}
and a.reject_sn like concat('%',#{rejectSn},'%')
and a.purchase_sn like concat('%',#{purchaseSn},'%')
and ss.name like concat('%',#{supplierName},'%')
and (pm.name like concat('%',#{monomerOrArea},'%') or pa.name like concat('%',#{monomerOrArea},'%') or ap.name like concat('%',#{monomerOrArea},'%'))
and a.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and a.specification like concat('%',#{specification},'%')
and a.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and a.reviewer_name like concat('%',#{reviewerName},'%')
and a.applicant_name like concat('%',#{applicantName},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.review_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{reviewTime[0]},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.review_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{reviewTime[1]},'%Y-%m-%d')
order by a.id desc
